clips.title: The story
paras: In Tinker Town, Klockmort's Creation takes shape through a new forging method. Gnome blacksmith Klockmort Spannerspan uses the rigorous technique devised by master armorsmith Furen Longbeard to make armor from raw materials.

Klockmort Spannerspan works in Tinker Town, where dwarven armor is usually forged at the Great Forge. With Furen Longbeard's rigorous methods, the gnome blacksmith finishes a pair of armored gauntlets. Dwarven metalworking and gnomish mechanical skill meet in gauntlets made to endure punishment that would crush ordinary steel.

Klockmort says the armor could be run over by a siege engine without lasting distortion. Its resilience comes from the peculiar treatment of rare components. Dwarven forging methods joined with gnomish ingenuity make armor fit to withstand the fiercest frontline battles.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Here's your armor, friend. Furen's process worked brilliantly! Perfectly! Marvelously, truly!
You could run this armor over with a siege engine and it would spring right back into shape!
